text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of Matikane Fukukitaru's Debut 
race has finally arrived!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*Thump-thump thump-thump*...! Wh-Wh-What 
is this overwhelming pressure~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"It feels just like back then. The day I 
went to draw a fortune slip for the very 
first time in my life, only to give up 
because I didn't have any change..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, I just can't calm down~! I'm so 
anxious, so worried...!"
choice_data_list: The gods are on our side.
The gods are on our side.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! I have a strong ally on 
my side, after all!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Thanks to that, my 
heart skipped a beat for a second. Well, 
it didn't literally stop, but still!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's say a quick prayer to the 
gods before the race...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"*Namu spinach, namu spinach*... The time 
to test my strength has finally come!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Listen here, God. The one being tested 
isn't my power, it's yours, okay? Please 
let me finish the run safely~~~
